latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Free to Editor — AI-powered video editing workflow.
- Upload raw footage, describe edits, and export 1080p videos in 1-2 minutes without timeline work.
- Automated cloud-based processing with support for cut, background music, text, aspect ratio, and more.
- Simple setup: automatic token retrieval and session creation.
- Official support for export formats: mp4, mov, avi, webm, mkv, jpg, png, gif, webp, mp3, wav, m4a, aac.
- Built-in error handling for common issues, including token expiry and file limits.
